pages.text: CO-165-01 Supplement to Asieroids Deluxe™ Operation, Maintenance and Service Manual (TM-165) Instructions for Game Option Settings Recent marketing surveys indicate our suggested settings of 3 ships and 50¢ per game need to be changed. Therefore, Asteroids Deluxe™ is shipped with 2 ships and 25¢ per game. Replace the figures in your Asteroids Deluxe™ Operation, Maintenance and Service Manual, ist printing with Figures 7 and 8 below. They show Atari’s current recommended settings. Please mark these changes in your manual and self-test label.
